Click an environment ↑

You spot a bug on production. You want to check on staging. New tab, retype the URL, swap the subdomain, hit Enter…

EnvJumper does that in one click.

Everything a multi-environment workflow needs

One-click switching

Path, query string and hash preserved. Open in the current tab or a new one.

Always know where you are

Colored border on the page, a label badge, and the environment initials on the toolbar icon.

CMS admin shortcuts

WordPress (incl. Multisite), Joomla, Drupal, PrestaShop, Magento and Shopify — detected automatically.

Your own quick links

A staging API, a metrics dashboard, a back office: one click away, on every environment.

Basic Auth handled

Password-protected staging? Enter the credentials once, EnvJumper answers the prompt for you.

Right-click to switch

Right-click any link on a recognized page and open it in another environment.

Share with your team

Export to JSON, send it to a colleague, import. Merge or replace — everyone gets the same setup.

Demo mode

Presenting to a client? Hide the border and badge from the settings in one toggle.

Your data stays on your device

Projects and credentials are stored locally in Chrome. No account, no server, no analytics. The only outside request is Google's favicon service, used when a project's icon can't be loaded directly.

Get started in a minute

Chrome Web Store

The easiest way: install it from the store and get automatic updates.

Add to Chrome

From source

  1. git clone https://github.com/drashka/EnvJumper.git
  2. Open chrome://extensions and enable Developer mode
  3. Click “Load unpacked” and select the folder

Alt + J opens the popup from anywhere.
